defects.rationale: Password/reset tokens are generated with the predictable random module instead of secrets, allowing attackers to guess tokens.
Reset tokens are built from random.randint, a predictable Mersenne Twister PRNG, so an attacker observing tokens can predict others and hijack account resets.
